facts.fact: Winter 用她在绞刑场骂过的 gracious 回敬
facts.anchor: He taunted her with the word she’d hurled at him during the hanging

facts.fact: 父亲多年追捕 Red Riding Hood，折损数十狼
facts.anchor: Spent countless resources and sacrificed dozens of wolves

facts.fact: 袭击前他确认外婆独居
facts.anchor: he’d made sure of it before assembling wolves to attack her

facts.fact: 他曾罚 Micah 三个月不得变身
facts.anchor: banning him from shifting for three months

facts.fact: 牢中男孩除绿眼外不像 Sterling
facts.anchor: There was almost no resemblance to Sterling that he could see besides their green eyes

facts.fact: 他告诉 Cyan：外婆曾是猎人首领
facts.anchor: She led a group of hunters before we killed her

facts.fact: Cyan 讨纸，说想给他折东西
facts.anchor: Will you bring a few sheets of paper

facts.fact: 命令天亮带两打人类囚犯来
facts.anchor: Bring two dozen human prisoners here at first light

facts.fact: 规则：她对两打人类，唯一幸存者得自由
facts.anchor: You against two dozen humans. The sole survivor earns their freedom

facts.fact: 她问这公平吗——他答“不公平”
facts.anchor: He licked the gravy from the fork and chuckled. “It’s not.”
